rows.note: Use 速度 as the all-purpose noun for a general or measurable rate of motion, including the broad idea of moving quickly.

example.english: This car's speed is really high.
example.traditional: 呢架車嘅速度真係好高。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 ce1 ge3 cuk1 dou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gou1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that someone or something is going fast.

example.english: I speed along in my car.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaa3 ce1 haang4 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use this specifically when a person or vehicle exceeds the legal speed limit, rather than merely moving fast.

example.english: They speed past the limit and get stopped by the police.
example.traditional: 佢揸車超速，俾警察截停咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zaa1 ce1 ciu1 cuk1 bei2 ging2 caat3 zit6 ting4 zo2

rows.note: Use 快慢 for the colloquial contrast of how fast or slow something is, rather than for a measured rate.

example.english: We don't need to compete over speed; safety comes first.
example.traditional: 我哋唔使鬥快慢，安全最緊要。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 sai2 dau3 faai3 maan6 on1 cyun4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3

rows.note: Use this when something is made to happen at a higher rate, rather than describing how fast it is already going.

example.english: We need to speed up production so we can finish on time.
example.traditional: 我哋要加快生產，先趕得切。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaa1 faai3 sang1 caan2 sin1 gon2 dak1 cit3
